details: Ultragoal session initialized: add settings switch to override fast track mode so full swarm is utilized on simple tasks.
Goal 1 completed: Added forceFullSwarm to AppSettings, SwarmEngineSettings, SettingsModal Swarm tab UI, and App.tsx state.
Goal 2 completed: Extended ModelRouter (evaluateFastPath, isFastPathEligible, inferComplexity), SwarmEngine, server.ts, and SwarmClient to honor forceFullSwarm override.
Goal 3 completed: Added unit tests in failover-timeout.test.ts and test-portable-swarm.ts; built client and swarm bundles; all 5 test suites passed (portable, simulation, dist, cli, server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Implement dynamic task routing to prevent resource bottlenecks and balance token allocation across specialist agents.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented TokenBudgetManager and SpecialistAffinityRouter in src/swarm/loadBalancer.ts; added comprehensive test suite in loadBalancer.test.ts (7/7 tests passed); all builds and test suites passing.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated dynamic specialist routing into src/swarm/engine.ts (Step 4), routing chunks to best-suited specialists via domain affinity and token capacity, emitting 'Specialist Dynamic Routing' events, and verified 100% passing tests in engine-routing.test.ts.

Goal 3 completed: Wired dynamic routing and token budget telemetry into SwarmEventTimeline UI, built both client and swarm production bundles, and verified 100% passing across all 5 test suites and 8 vitest suites.
Ultragoal session initialized: Swarm Optimization Roadmap (Priority 1: Key Metrics Baselines, Priority 2: Semantic Baseline Caching, Priority 3: Reinforcement Learning Adaptive Scheduling).

Goal 1 completed: Implemented SwarmMetricsCollector and calculateLatencyDistribution in src/swarm/profiler.ts, integrated telemetry baselines into src/swarm/engine.ts, and verified 100% passing tests in profiler.test.ts, engine-routing.test.ts, and all 5 E2E suites.

Goal 2 completed: Implemented SemanticSimilarityEngine and SemanticBaselineCache in src/swarm/cache.ts, integrated Step 0c semantic cache short-circuit in src/swarm/engine.ts, verified 12/12 passing tests in cache.test.ts, rebuilt dist/swarm, and verified all 5 E2E suites passing.

Goal 3 completed: Implemented SpecialistCapabilityProfiler with UCB1 reward scoring in src/swarm/loadBalancer.ts, integrated RL capability scoring into SpecialistAffinityRouter and Step 4 routing/outcomes in src/swarm/engine.ts, verified 11/11 tests in loadBalancer.test.ts and 4/4 in engine-routing.test.ts, rebuilt dist/swarm, and passed 100% of all 5 E2E suites and 52 unit tests.
